title: QueueApi
description:
Landing-queue API surface — compound root type aggregating all landing-
queue sub-types (decomposition §1, item 9).

The committed JSON Schema is the schema of this root type.

Frozen by WP-00.

batch_id.description: Batch identifier for the current or most recent batch.

seal.description: Seal record for the current or most recent batch.

union_result.description: Union merge result for the current batch.

BatchSeal.description: Seal record for a completed landing batch.

minimal_failing_pair.description:
The minimal failing pair if the batch is in a failed state (absent
when the batch succeeded).

order_index.description: Queue position / ordering index of this batch.

union_tree.description: Merkle tree hash of the sealed (committed) tree.

LandableEntry.description: A single entry in the landable queue (PR / change ready to land).

intent_id.description: intent_id of the associated PR sidecar.

item_id.description: Unique identifier for this landable item.

tree_hash.description: Merkle tree hash of the change's workspace snapshot.

MinimalFailingPair.description: The minimal failing pair in a batch (two items whose union fails).

item_a.description: First item of the failing pair.

item_b.description: Second item of the failing pair.

UnionResult.description: Union merge result for a batch.

conflict_free.description: Whether the union merge succeeded without conflicts.

union_tree.description: Merkle tree hash of the union-merged workspace.
